profile.name: Naman Daryani
profile.title: Founder & Director
profile.bio: Entrepreneur based in Indore, MP. Building Exharnet (Interior & Architectural Surfaces Wholesale across MP) and Geba India (Handcrafted Sustainable Luxury Accessories).

businesses.name: Exharnet

products.name: Mica & Laminates
products.desc: High-pressure decorative laminates in bespoke textures and luxury finishes.

products.name: Architectural Louvers
products.desc: Fluted, interior acoustic, and exterior wall cladding louvers.

products.desc: Ultra-gloss and scratch-resistant interior acrylic panels.
